cutsceneModel.notes: A cutscene is normal gameplay with scripted control layered on top. Dialogue will use the ordinary gameplay dialogue UI, automatically swap the active speaker from line metadata, never move the player unless a beat explicitly asks for it, and never make NPCs face/headtrack the player unless authored.

rescue.title: Prologue — The Rescue
rescue.notes: First-pass map test intentionally uses the complete normal Southern Cloud Forest zone. This lets ordinary generated ground, seasonal grass/materials, cloud-forest fog, vegetation, and loading-screen behavior initialize exactly as they do during gameplay. A dedicated tiny authored prologue map can replace this mapId later without changing the cutscene controller model.

hunundi_room.title: Prologue — Father Hunundi's Room
hunundi_room.notes: Loads Father Hunundi's existing authored room through the ordinary building/interior runtime. Dialogue is intentionally empty during the map-flow pass.
